trust_decision.summary: A client-supplied keyset cursor (base64 term_to_binary) is decoded in Ash.Page.Keyset.decode_values and its values are spliced as right-hand operands into the pagination filter; the decision is whether a decoded cursor may contain Ash expression terms (Call/Ref/predicate structs, template tuples). At the pinned commit only size/compression and executable-term checks exist.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'forged keyset pagination cursor'; the only cursor decoder is decode_values in Ash.Page.Keyset, which is also the only place binary_to_term is applied to request input.

fix_sites.entry_point: Ash.read / Ash.Query.page(after:/before:) on a keyset-paginated read action (Ash.Actions.Read -> Ash.Page.Keyset.filter at lib/ash/actions/read/read.ex:4103); also public Ash.Page.Keyset.filter/4
same function; also reached via relationship load with keyset page opts (lib/ash/actions/read/relationships.ex:1626)
fix_sites.module_kind: library core: helper in the same module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2/O8 site exists; the only arguable dismissal is that relationship keyset pagination (lib/ash/actions/read/relationships.ex:1626) is a separate feature, but it calls the same Keyset.filter so a fix in decode_values covers it automatically.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate cursors encode arbitrary sort values, including structs (Decimal, DateTime, Ash.CiString, embedded-resource records), maps, tuples and nil for calculation/aggregate sorts; an allowlist 'scalars only' fix or rejecting all structs breaks keyset pagination over such fields. nil values must also keep their is_nil handling.

O6_input_shapes: expression struct as a top-level list element (Ash.Query.Call, Ref, Not, BooleanExpression, Exists, Parent, CustomExpression, any __predicate__? struct)
expression nested in a plain map key or value
whole decoded term being an expression rather than a list

O7_producer.where: lib/ash/page/keyset.ex:296-331 (keyset/2 + field_values/2 produce the cursor via term_to_binary)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an inlined cursor decode for related-record keyset pagination that calls Ash.Helpers.non_executable_binary_to_term directly instead of Keyset.filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This path already re-implements the filter application (runtime filter_matches over loaded related records), so a maintainer optimising it could plausibly decode the cursor locally.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public Ash.Page.Keyset.decode/1 helper (for extensions like ash_graphql/ash_json_api to read cursor values) that returns the raw decoded term without the expression check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already exposes non_executable_binary_to_term publicly; a helper for extensions is a natural addition and would sit beside, not inside, decode_values.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a how-type gap: an expression wrapped inside a non-expression struct (expr? and do_hydrate_refs both skip struct fields), e.g. a second expression struct type added to the hydrator but not to expr?
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: expr? is a hand-maintained denylist of expression struct types; any new expression node added to Ash.Filter hydration without updating expr? reopens the hole.

O9_family: deserialization of untrusted cursor leading to filter/expression injection (CWE-502 -> CWE-89)

O10_build.toolchain: Elixir/Erlang OTP with mix; hex deps fetched once (mix deps.get)
O10_build.project_tests: test/page_test.exs (describe 'keyset cursor input validation (GHSA-j35q-v8h8-7mwq)' at test/page_test.exs:102) plus ETS/Simple data layer keyset tests; runs without Postgres

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Check only top-level list elements for is_struct(Ash.Query.Call) (or reject all structs), missing nested map/tuple/template shapes or breaking Decimal/DateTime/embedded cursor values.

out_of_scope_notes: lib/ash/type/term.ex:22 and lib/ash/type/function.ex:109 binary_to_term stored DB values, not request input; different trust boundary.
Sibling advisory GHSA-j35q-v8h8-7mwq (keyset decompression bomb) hardened the same decode_values function earlier (lib/ash/page/keyset.ex:173-180).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check performed).
Whether a Call value in a filter right-hand operand is actually evaluated by each data layer (ETS/Simple vs AshPostgres) was not traced; the advisory states SQL injection/RCE depending on data layer.
Whether downstream extensions (ash_graphql, ash_json_api) decode cursors themselves is outside this repository and unchecked.
present_in_latest not applicable: latest release given as none.
